coverage.notes: The official Study@SJTU undergraduate catalogue was checked by degree-program teaching-language headings: English-taught Engineering Cluster; English-taught Civil Engineering; English-taught Sustainable Energy and Health Science and Technology; and the separately administered School of Medicine English-taught MBBS. The Engineering Cluster is ONE first-year application route with later major selection, not multiple independent first-year degrees. Chinese-taught and French-taught routes, postgraduate study and non-degree/pre-university study are excluded. The 2027 Engineering Cluster is documented, but Civil Engineering, GIFT programmes and MBBS presently have accessible 2026 intake instructions only, so 2027 availability and complete list cannot be certified. The SJTU 2027 cluster page and GC site appeared with updated 2027 content in the current official-site web index while a separate page-opening cache sometimes displayed the previous 2026 version; 2027 claims therefore need especially careful direct recheck before publication.

institution.summary: Shanghai-based public research university founded in 1896; international undergraduate routes include engineering, future technology and medicine.

programmes.name: Undergraduate Engineering Cluster Program in English
programmes.credential: Bachelor's degree in chosen engineering major after the cluster phase
programmes.campus: Global College, Minhang campus, Shanghai (first 1.5 years)
programmes.language: English in initial cluster; later major taught in English or Chinese; Chinese language/culture modules required
programmes.about: An English-delivered first-year engineering entry cluster that moves into undergraduate majors across SJTU after introductory study at Global College.
programmes.overview: Students begin with one and a half years of introductory engineering courses at Global College, rather than applying immediately to each eventual major. Later destinations may include mechanical engineering, electrical and computer engineering, materials, automation, computer science, power and energy, and data science; available choices are subject to change. Subsequent major teaching may be in English or Chinese, with Chinese-language and culture classes during the degree. The route leads to a bachelor's degree in the selected engineering field and includes a Chinese-language graduation standard with specified exceptions.

programmes.name: BEng in Civil Engineering (Smart and Sustainable Construction)
programmes.about: An English-taught civil engineering degree focused on digital infrastructure, intelligent construction and sustainable design.
programmes.overview: The programme combines civil and structural engineering foundations with smart-construction technologies and lower-carbon design. Its published curriculum highlights digital twins, intelligent sensing, construction robotics, green buildings and sustainable infrastructure. A theory-and-practice approach includes project work and engineering activities linked to industry, with access to laboratories covering materials and structural behaviour. The official description identifies applications in resilient infrastructure, urban renewal, digital asset management and further engineering study.

programmes.name: Sustainable Energy
programmes.campus: Minhang campus, Shanghai (Global Institute of Future Technology)
programmes.language: English-taught, with compulsory Chinese language/culture study
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary engineering degree connecting sustainable energy, artificial intelligence and energy-system design.
programmes.overview: The programme starts with mathematics, physics, chemistry and engineering foundations, including computing, electricity, mechanics and materials. Its interdisciplinary curriculum examines energy materials, energy systems, energy management and the use of digital methods to address energy problems. Students take humanities courses alongside practical engineering and research activities, with opportunities to choose courses for an individual study direction. The resulting preparation spans technical development and system planning in sustainable energy rather than a single conventional engineering speciality.

programmes.name: Health Science and Technology
programmes.campus: Minhang campus, Shanghai (Global Institute of Future Technology)
programmes.language: English-taught, with compulsory Chinese language/culture study
programmes.about: A technology-focused engineering degree bringing AI, data and design methods into proactive health and health-system applications.
programmes.overview: Study combines mathematics, physics, computing and engineering foundations with biology and bioengineering. Interdisciplinary areas include big data and AI for health, intelligent health systems, health-science foundations, and the relationship between health and society. The course structure mixes required study with chosen interdisciplinary modules and practical or research work. It prepares students to design and evaluate technology for health applications; it is an engineering degree, not the School of Medicine's clinical medicine qualification.

programmes.name: Clinical Medicine (MBBS, English-taught)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
programmes.campus: Shanghai, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine (multiple affiliated clinical settings)
programmes.language: English-taught (2026 MBBS); any Chinese/clinical language conditions unverified
programmes.about: A six-year English-taught, direct-entry clinical medicine programme offered by SJTU School of Medicine for international students.
programmes.overview: Students enter after secondary school and study clinical medicine through a six-year undergraduate programme. Training covers basic medical sciences and clinical medicine, with public-health and research components alongside clinical practice in the School of Medicine's affiliated hospital network. The medical school operates a dedicated international admissions system, separate from the engineering application route. Graduates receive the MBBS qualification; inclusion in an international medical-school directory does not itself establish eligibility for professional registration in Denmark or elsewhere.
